{e0:3C0B}{spk:E783}{fa:0080}{n}On the surface there are those whose hearts are like ours, gripped by chaos, destruction, death and revenge.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:3D0B}{spk:E783}{fa:0080}{n}I simply reached out to such people, just as the angel beside you does now.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:3E0B}{spk:E783}{fa:0080}{n}Do you understand?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{e0:4D0B}{spk:E783}{fa:0080}{n}Of course, a human like you could hardly grasp what perfect minds like ours truly desire.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:4E0B}{spk:E783}{fa:0080}{n}But if you could touch Gaap-sama's great power and thoughts directly, surely even you would understand.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:4F0B}{spk:E783}{fa:0080}{n}You would see the majesty of his power at once, and fall to your knees.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:500B}{spk:E783}{fa:0080}{n}After all, so did I, and only a hundred years ago I stood where the angel behind you stands now.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:510B}{spk:E783}{fa:0080}{n}...Still, I can't let you appear before Gaap-sama as you are.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:520B}{spk:E783}{fa:0080}{n}Unless I pull off an arm or a leg or two before I take you to him, you might be rude to Gaap-sama.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:530B}{spk:E783}{fa:0080}{n}Now, raise your weapon.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:540B}{spk:E783}{fa:0080}{n}You need to be punished!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
